title: O.C.G.A. § 9-3-33 — Actions for injuries to person or property
content:
O.C.G.A. § 9-3-33

Except as otherwise provided in this article, actions for injuries to the person shall be brought within two years after the right of action accrues.

title: O.C.G.A. § 11-2-725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
O.C.G.A. § 11-2-725

(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within four years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than one year but may not extend it.

title: Landmark American Insurance Co. v. Rogers, 254 Ga. 710 (1985)
content:
Landmark American Insurance Co. v. Rogers, 254 Ga. 710 (1985).

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Supreme Court of Georgia addressed insurance contract interpretation and held that ambiguous policy language is construed against the insurer as the drafter.

opinionParts.content: Ambiguous insurance policy language is construed against the insurer as the drafter.
